patterns.name: P-01
patterns.title: Gates red on clean tree / health not self-certifying
patterns.root_cause: Gate definitions are strict but pre-existing debt makes them permanently red; no staged-scope or threshold
patterns.structural_fix: Make gap-scanner staged-scope or thresholded; fix or archive legacy dead code (meal_library, dev_domain_adapter); let M4 run naturally; reconnect stale spool source

patterns.name: P-02
patterns.title: Derived artifacts / docs out of sync
patterns.root_cause: No single source of truth for every number; docs drift from code
patterns.structural_fix: model-spec.json single source (done); extend provenance to backtest.py; reconcile axiom-count references; DNS cleanup

patterns.name: P-03
patterns.title: Research written but not consolidated/published
patterns.root_cause: Components exist but no narrative entity; publish pipeline gated on manual steps
patterns.structural_fix: Write the working paper; publish brief-52; then resource legs extend the same paper

patterns.name: P-04
patterns.title: Work accumulates unshipped / no canonical tracking
patterns.root_cause: No single place lists gaps; commits gated or forgotten
patterns.structural_fix: This tracker (done); commit TELOS work; auto-check tracker in self-audit; DONE=SHIPPED gate

patterns.name: P-05
patterns.title: Bots/skills kept alive past usefulness
patterns.root_cause: No lifecycle review; removal feels like loss
patterns.structural_fix: Audit every bot/skill: if not useful now → remove, then redesign better to the goal (architect mandate). Retire, don't accumulate.

patterns.name: P-06
patterns.title: Conversation-only learning / counter-reset scheduling (LESSONS NOT PERSISTED)
patterns.root_cause: Learning happens in chat and is never written into the system; wall-clock schedules gated on restart-resetting counters
patterns.structural_fix: telos/lessons/ record appended to every session; data captures gated on persisted last-run-date not cycleCount; >2-round fixes MUST be recorded

patterns.name: P-07
patterns.title: Freshness judged by file count instead of per-source cadence
patterns.root_cause: File counts in a directory are historical artifacts, not freshness signals
patterns.structural_fix: Staleness = age vs per-source expectedIntervalMinutes from spool cursors (monitor.js 08-02). Never judge health by listing files.

patterns.name: P-08
patterns.title: Secrets hardcoded in code / pushed to remote
patterns.root_cause: No secret hygiene gate; tokens embedded in scripts for convenience
patterns.structural_fix: env vars + gitignored .env.local; secret-scan before push; on GH013 rotate (revoke + recreate), never just delete

patterns.name: P-09
patterns.title: Wrong-slot diagnosis (near-identical source names, wrong directory)
patterns.root_cause: Freshness checked against a guessed path instead of the canonical source key from config
patterns.structural_fix: Resolve source keys from CONFIG.endpoints; confirm canonical location before declaring staleness
